Beneath the Same Blue-Istanbul Modern.name: Beneath the Same Blue
Beneath the Same Blue-Istanbul Modern.description: Istanbul Modern’s 10th collection exhibition brings together works by artists from Türkiye and different parts of the world, produced across various periods and geographies, along historical and thematic axes. Spanning the museum’s Dr. Nejat F. Eczacıbaşı Permanent Exhibition Gallery and different floors of the museum, the exhibition traces the transformation of modern and contemporary art in Türkiye since the 1940s, while offering new ways of reading the collection through encounters and…

Semiha Berksoy: Aria of All Colors-Istan.name: Semiha Berksoy: Aria of All Colors
Semiha Berksoy: Aria of All Colors-Istan.description: “Aria of All Colors,” a major exhibition devoted to Semiha Berksoy (1910–2004), celebrates a pioneering artist whose versatility and resolve enabled her to break new ground in both Türkiye and Europe. The exhibition brings together her expansive body of work – spanning the performing arts, visual arts, cinema, and literature – and offers a comprehensive look at the creative universe she built over the course of her extraordinary career. With more than 200 works on view, the exhibition makes…

Panorama: Dreams and Places-Istanbul Mod.name: Panorama: Dreams and Places
Panorama: Dreams and Places-Istanbul Mod.description: Aiming to present a thematic narrative on contemporary photography and lens-based art in Türkiye, “Panorama: Dreams and Places” brings together a comprehensive selection of works produced since the 2010s by 18 artists from different generations. The exhibition is on view in the galleries on the first floor of Istanbul Modern.

Renzo Piano: Genius Loci-Istanbul Modern.name: Renzo Piano: Genius Loci
Renzo Piano: Genius Loci-Istanbul Modern.description: “Renzo Piano: Genius Loci” focuses on the architecture of Istanbul Modern’s new museum building and its design and construction process, which spanned six years. Designed by Renzo Piano Building Workshop (RPBW), the new building greets art lovers at the same location where Istanbul Modern opened its doors in 2004 as Türkiye's first museum of modern and contemporary art.

Manuel \u00c7\u0131tak: An Island of One.name: Manuel Çıtak: An Island of One’s Own
Manuel \u00c7\u0131tak: An Island of One.description: The Istanbul Modern Photography Gallery hosts a solo exhibition of works by Manuel Çıtak (1962–2023), spanning from the 1980s, when he first took up photography, to his untimely passing in 2023. Comprising works that focus on human existence in the city, on urban peripheries, and across rural landscapes, “An Island of One’s Own” aims to illuminate Çıtak’s poetic dialogue with documentary photography.

Ali Kazma: Landscapes of the Mind-Istanb.name: Ali Kazma: Landscapes of the Mind
Ali Kazma: Landscapes of the Mind-Istanb.description: “Landscapes of the Mind” at Istanbul Modern Photography Gallery focuses on works revealing the writer’s mind through the metaphor of landscape painting by Ali Kazma (b. 1971), one of today’s leading lens-based artists, whose practice explores fundamental questions about the meaning of human activity. The exhibition features videos from the 2010s to the present focused on books and literature and a selection of photographs from the artist’s extensive archive.

\u00d6mer Ulu\u00e7: Beyond the Horizon-.name: Ömer Uluç: Beyond the Horizon
\u00d6mer Ulu\u00e7: Beyond the Horizon-.description: Istanbul Modern presents the solo exhibition of Ömer Uluç (1931–2010) titled “Beyond the Horizon,” which showcases his artistic journey. Bringing together different forms of expression that are key in the artist’s practice through various themes, it features a comprehensive selection of works from the 1960s to 2010.

\u0130zzet Keribar: Journey of Colors-Is.name: İzzet Keribar: Journey of Colors
\u0130zzet Keribar: Journey of Colors-Is.description: "Journey of Colors" presents a selection from İzzet Keribar's (b. 1936) vast archive of nearly 1.5 million images. The exhibition highlights the formal elements that have become the artist’s trademark, such as color, light, texture, and graphic composition. It also reveals the artist's evolving style over the years, inviting viewers on a vibrant journey through different times and places.

Chiharu Shiota: Between Worlds-Istanbul.name: Chiharu Shiota: Between Worlds
Chiharu Shiota: Between Worlds-Istanbul.description: Chiharu Shiota's solo exhibition “Between Worlds,” organized on Istanbul Modern’s invitation as part of the 100th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Japan and Türkiye, centers on the artist's sense of being “somewhere in between.” In shaping the exhibition’s conceptual framework, Shiota draws on Istanbul's location between Asia and Europe. She is also inspired by Istanbul Modern's location in Karaköy, one of the city’s busiest districts and home to its historic,…

Olafur Eliasson: Your unexpected encount.name: Olafur Eliasson: Your unexpected encounter
Olafur Eliasson: Your unexpected encount.description: Olafur Eliasson's first solo exhibition in Türkiye, “Your unexpected encounter,” reflects the artist's deep interest in light, color, perception, movement, geometry, and the environment. The artworks also reveal the network of relationships the artist forges between broad areas of research and his multidisciplinary practice. As well as following the personal journey of the artist, the exhibition addresses navigation and orientation on a wider scale, inspired by the site of the museum and its…

Ozan Sa\u011fd\u0131\u00e7: The Photogra.name: Ozan Sağdıç: The Photographer’s Testimony
Ozan Sa\u011fd\u0131\u00e7: The Photogra.description: “The Photographer’s Testimony” presents a wide selection of works by Ozan Sağdıç (b. 1934), one of the most prominent names in the history of photography in Türkiye. The exhibition focuses on documentary photography, a widespread genre of photography in the world, while also shedding light on the country’s social, political, economic, cultural, and visual history from the 1950s to the present day.

Yoko Ono: Insound and Instructure-Sak\u0.name: Yoko Ono: Insound and Instructure
Yoko Ono: Insound and Instructure-Sak\u0.description: Sabancı University Sakıp Sabancı Museum (SSM) presents the most comprehensive exhibition of Yoko Ono’s work ever presented in Türkiye, realised with the support of Akbank and in collaboration with MUSAC, Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Castilla y León in León, Spain. Yoko Ono: Insound and Instructure presents an extensive selection from over seventy years of artistic production by Yoko Ono, whose career began in the avant-garde milieu of New York in the late 1950s. Comprising 67 works, including…

Scribbled Exercises, Practice Pages-Sak\.name: Scribbled Exercises, Practice Pages
Scribbled Exercises, Practice Pages-Sak\.description: The exhibition “Scribbled Exercises, Practice Pages” brings together the scribbled exercises and practice pages of Ottoman calligraphers, presenting master calligraphers from the sixteenth to the twentieth century. The selection features scribbled exercises and practice pages from the Arts of the Book and Calligraphy Collection of Sabancı University Sakıp Sabancı Museum, alongside works from the collection of Kubbealtı Academy Cultural and Arts Foundation. It includes works by calligraphers…

Sak\u0131p Sabanc\u0131 Museum Painting.name: Sakıp Sabancı Museum Painting Collection
Sak\u0131p Sabanc\u0131 Museum Painting.description: Approached through a thematic and chronological narrative that considers the forces shaping the changing visual culture of a given era, the Sakıp Sabancı Museum Painting Collection extends from nineteenth-century Ottoman painting to twentieth-century examples of modern Turkish art. Initiated by Sakıp Sabancı, a prominent businessperson, in the 1970s, and enriched over time through new acquisitions and long-term loans, the collection is presented to visitors in the museum’s modern galleries with…

Sak\u0131p Sabanc\u0131 Museum The Arts.name: Sakıp Sabancı Museum The Arts of the Book and Calligraphy Collection
Sak\u0131p Sabanc\u0131 Museum The Arts.description: Sakıp Sabancı’s (d. 2004) collection of calligraphic works by famous calligraphers, Korans and illuminated manuscripts began with the purchase of a levha (calligraphic panel) by Sultan Mahmud II (r. 1808-39). From 1989 onwards it was exhibited in major museums abroad. The keen interest attracted by these exhibitions cemented Sakıp Sabancı and his family’s resolve to further enlarge the collection and encouraged the idea of founding a museum. In 1998 the family mansion Atlı Köşk (the Mansion…

Suzanne Lacy: Birlikte/Tog\u00e6ther-Sak.name: Suzanne Lacy: Birlikte/Togæther
Suzanne Lacy: Birlikte/Tog\u00e6ther-Sak.description: Sabancı University Sakıp Sabancı Museum presents Suzanne Lacy’s Birlikte/Togæther , the first exhibition in Turkey by the American artist and educator. Recognized as a pioneer of feminist art and of participatory, community-oriented performance, Lacy’s exhibition is on view through Sunday, March 8, 2026, with the support of the Sabancı Foundation. This first exhibition in Turkey presents selections from Suzanne Lacy’s long-term practice, which turns participation, solidarity, and mutual…

Georg Baselitz: The Last Decade-Sak\u013.name: Georg Baselitz: The Last Decade
Georg Baselitz: The Last Decade-Sak\u013.description: For tickets, click here . For the chronology text, click here . Georg Baselitz: The Last Decade at the Sabancı University Sakıp Sabancı Museum (SSM), with the support of Akbank, presents works by German painter, printmaker, and sculptor Georg Baselitz, a leading figure in contemporary art. The exhibition features close to one hundred large-scale paintings and sculptures created by Baselitz in the past decade, displayed throughout all gallery spaces and the garden of the SSM.
